description: Use when configuring SSR environments, edge workers, custom environments, or migrating to the Vite 6+ environment model. Prevents using the Environment API on Vite 5 (where it does not exist) and misconfiguring per-environment vs shared plugin scoping. Covers per-environment build and dev settings, EnvironmentOptions interface, custom environment providers, shared vs per-environment plugins, configuration inheritance, and migration from Vite 5 implicit environments. Keywords: vite, environment api, vite 6, SSR, edge workers, per-environment config, providers.
